chunks.title: lecture

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: What it does?

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: For all the transactions that were committed or successfully completed.

chunks.title: lecture

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: But the changes in the transaction or history, have not been saved in our disk or database.

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Their operations are written to ensure all intents and modifications are applied.

chunks.title: lecture

chunks.title: lecture

chunks.title: lecture

chunks.text: This is the backup of the entire database.

chunks.text: Now we need the backup of the entire database from 5 days to date.
